speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Vulvodynia (specifically entry dyspareunia secondary to pelvic floor dysfunction).

Please note that the previous suggestion of Multiple Sclerosis is incorrect given the absence of neurological deficits, normal other system reviews, and the specific localization of pain to vaginal penetration. While the pain can be physically real, your history of body dysmorphic disorder may be amplifying the perception of threat and discomfort. We will proceed with pelvic floor physical therapy and cognitive-behavioral strategies to manage these symptoms.
